```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: cargo test --all -- --nocapture > flaky_report.txt

      - name: Upload flaky report as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky_report.txt

  flaky-monitor-persist:
    needs: flaky-monitor
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Download previous flaky report
        id: download_flaky_report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky_report_previous.txt

      - name: Append current flaky report to previous one
        run: |
          cat flaky_report.txt >> flaky_report_previous.txt
          mv flaky_report_previous.txt flaky_report.txt

      - name: Upload updated flaky report as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky_report.txt

  notify-slack:
    needs: [flaky-monitor, flaky-monitor-persist]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get PR number
        id: get_pr_number
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number::${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}"

      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
        with:
          owner: spellshift
          slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          pr_number: ${{ steps.get_pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}
```
